title: Cash & settlements
subtitle: Every euro received stays with its holder until it is handed over to the Company Account.
alertNote_one: Balances older than {{count}} day alert on the dashboard (Settings → Cash).
alertNote_other: Balances older than {{count}} days alert on the dashboard (Settings → Cash).

summary.heldOutsideSub: Partners and cash box, not yet handed over

balances.title: Balances
balances.emptyHint: Money holders (partners, cash box, Company Account) are managed in Settings.
balances.overdue_one: Unsettled since {{date}} — older than {{count}} day. Hand it over to the Company Account.
balances.overdue_other: Unsettled since {{date}} — older than {{count}} days. Hand it over to the Company Account.
balances.negative: More handed over than received — check for receipts that were not recorded.
balances.companyHint: Settlements from partners and the cash box land here.

handover.title: Hand over money
handover.intro: Record money that a holder has passed on, normally to the Company Account. It reduces the holder's balance.
handover.notePlaceholder: e.g. bank deposit, cash counted at the shop

overdrawn.title: More than the current holding
overdrawn.message: {{name}} is only holding {{holding}} according to the recorded receipts. Handing over {{amount}} would leave a balance of {{result}}.
overdrawn.advice: Check the amount first. Record anyway only if the money really changed hands — for example when some receipts have not been entered yet.

validation.fromRequired: Choose who is handing the money over
validation.amountPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero
validation.noteTooLong: The note can be at most 500 characters
validation.sameHolder: The receiver must be different from the giver

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Receipts and handovers of all holders, newest first.
ledger.descriptionHolder: Receipts and handovers of {{name}}, newest first.
ledger.emptyHint: Payments received and handovers will appear here.
ledger.emptyFilteredHint: Nothing matches these filters. Try another holder or date range.

history.title: Handovers
history.description: Every recorded handover. Voiding one returns the amount to the giver's holding.
history.emptyHint: When a partner or the cash box passes money to the Company Account, record it as a handover.

void.title: Void this handover?
void.message: {{amount}} handed over by {{from}} to {{to}} on {{date}} will be voided. The amount returns to {{from}}'s holding. The record stays in the audit log.
